author: Xbox
description:
Wake up alone on a space station. Your crew is gone. Time loops. Only your mind can break the cycle. 

Rivage is a first-person sci-fi puzzle adventure set aboard the A.R.E.S. space station, trapped in a mysterious space phenomenon. You play as Miranda, a researcher stuck in an infinite time loop. Your crew has vanished, only their journals, recordings, and personal belongings remain. Explore the station to solve puzzles and piece together what happened.

Your companion K9 tracks your discoveries across loops, helping you connect the dots and push further with every cycle.

Rivage is coming to Xbox Series X|S in 2026.

https://www.xbox.com/games/store/rivage/9NZVRP8QQZ6N

Developed by Exnilo Studio
Published by Raw Fury

author: Xbox
description:
Prepare for another epic adventure in the magical world of Kitaria in this fun action RPG complete with farming and crafting, coming to Xbox Series X|S!

Across the great expanse of the Endless Ocean lies the Arkadera Peninsula, a distant region that once marked the western edge of the Empire. As the years passed and the Empire’s presence began to fade, the outposts that once protected Arkadera’s citizens were gradually reclaimed by nature, leaving behind a small community to take refuge in the walled haven of Whitewall Town.

Eager to prove their skills in the field, ambitious Royal Army ‘Pathfinder’ Alice Skylar and plucky local guide Dusty Tuftkin join up with the Royal Academy Expedition Team on its mission to reopen Whitewall Town’s fabled errand house, explore the wide peninsula, and restore the long-forgotten outposts.

But as the expedition journeys farther into the north, rumours of a mysterious figure deep within the wilderness slowly begin to surface…

https://www.microsoft
title: Kitaria Fables 2 | Announcement Trailer
